other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal on the date of making an application
Applicant must not be a beneficiary under any other Social Security pension scheme or a recipient of any government or other organization pension
Applicant must be a financially distressed/economically backward practicing priest attached to any place of worship
For the housing grant, the applicant must not own a pucca dwelling house unless they own a piece of land in their name; if land is not owned, the government may provide land
benefits_summary: Eligible poor priests receive a monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 and a one‑time housing grant of ₹1,20,000 for house construction.
documents_required: Document proving residential status in West Bengal
